sophia_ml: heads-up: cassiopeia11b v1-int4 canary started. Seeing two failure modes: (1) sporadic OOMs on long-gen, (2) steady fragmentation over time even at low qps.
ryan_runtime: Which model config? microbatch, kv_prefetch, quant profile?
sophia_ml: microbatch=6, kv_prefetch=true, quant_profile=per_tensor_int4, max_new_tokens=768.
taylor_infra: GPU pool=beta, H100-80G. Logs show repeated allocate/free patterns causing many small free blocks. Example trace:
```
W runtime: freed slot 0x7f2a... size=64MiB
I runtime: alloc 0x7f2a... size=1.1GiB -> failed: CUDA OOM
metrics: slot_frag_rate=0.18, free_frag_blocks=372
```
mike_eval: Perf numbers vs 6b on our summarization eval: 11b int4 quality +3.4% but latency +25% at 512 tokens.
karen_prod: If we need to keep 11b live, can we tune defaults so 6b fallback only for >512 tokens? Customers expect top quality but we need reliability.
ryan_runtime: Proposal:
- set default max_new_tokens=360
- max_microbatch=3
- disable kv_prefetch on coldstart (kv_prefetch=false)
- enable slot_compactor with compaction_interval=30s
taylor_infra: Also try `allocator_spin_reclaim=true` in runtime; it consolidates tiny freed blocks faster. For compactor, recommend slot_reserve=0.10.
sophia_ml: I can run two quick experiments:
A) per_tensor->per_channel quant for attention weights (re-quantize) to see mem delta
B) keep per_tensor but aggressive slot compaction + microbatch cap
mike_eval: For A, recall per_channel increases model size slightly but can reduce activation peak? Not sure. We should benchmark both.
ops-bot: scheduled test: canary-run A and B for 6h each starting 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z
sophia_ml: Quick local repro: with microbatch=6 + max_new_tokens=768 we hit an OOM at ~14m. With microbatch=3 and compactor on it's stable for 45m.
ryan_runtime: Good. Add canary smoke checks:
- OOM count <= 1 per 1000
- slot_frag_rate < 0.12
- p50 latency delta to baseline < 15%
karen_prod: Add routing rule: if request.max_new_tokens > 512 -> route to cassiopeia-6b-lite and annotate response with fallback_reason and quality_estimate.
sophia_ml: Will update model card: include observed frag patterns, recommended defaults (max_new_tokens=360, microbatch_max=3, kv_prefetch=false, slot_reserve=0.10), and canary results link.
taylor_infra: If compactor causes CPU spike, we may need to throttle compaction during peaks. Watch host CPU during canary.
mike_eval: I'll run the quality regression suite on 6b fallback to quantify the 11b->6b delta per task.
sophia_ml: Thanks team. Will post canary logs + perf dashboards after the 12h run. :v:
